newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU's grain panel to last meet on May 22 - official.
newsitem.headline: EU's grain panel to last meet on May 22 - official.

text.p: The European Union will hold the last weekly meeting of its grain panel for the 1996/97 season on May 22, an EU grain official said on Thursday.
The EU grain panel meets each week to adjudicate grain tenders. This thus leaves the EU seven weeks before officially closing down exports, he said.
"The EU grain panel will meet on March 20, April 3, April 10, April 17, April 24, May 15 and May 22," he said.
